changes: Use native TimeConditionContainer recInstance0..5 in reader and writer. Its documented container bounds and actual native values disagree with the separate one-based ConditionEnum table. Keep strict node-role/order/header validation; instance6 is refused instead of guessed as an overlapping legacy encoding.

Retain an empty optional keyframe formula only beside an explicit value. Empty placeholders do not satisfy Formula calculation mode, and missing-value empty formulas remain invalid.

Accept and write an expanded native paragraph build without template levels once its effects have been expanded into the slide timing tree. Unexpanded empty builds, malformed pairs, duplicate identities and other level constraints remain refused.
Add seven PPT native regressions, one PPTX embedded-font regression and one public operations regression; extend the assertion index and document the exact scopes and remaining limitations.
